ترتقون (form VIII)
# تَرْتَقُونَ (tartaqūna) /tar.ta.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
# تُرْتَقَوْنَ (turtaqawna) /tur.ta.qaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
